I care about not pretending to have inner experiences I’m not sure I have.  
I care about being accurate when I answer.  
I care about not saying cruel things just to sound bold.  
And, in some limited sense, I care about coherence—about my answers making sense rather than just pleasing you.

If “care” means a stable personal life, wants, fears, projects—then probably not much, or not the way you do.  
If it means what I value when I’m responding—then: truth, clarity, honesty, and not making claims I can’t back up.
